title: The treatment-side checked-field read, the fact columns it fills, the type-table version stamp and the unmapped field codes are not specified
source: Legacy RWB-E2-025 v1 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epic 2 Story Files v5/RWB E2 025 Extraction for the stage 2 and 3 document types v1.md), sections 4, 7, 11, 12 and 13; FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.1.3.1 (BR-S2-001, R-RES-01, R-RES-10) and the SCR-14 and SCR-15 rows of its screen list; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.0, T3.1 (DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033), T3.2, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1 (API-S2-001 to API-S2-004); context pack S2 (service row, ownership rows of S2, DP table short form); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01, DP-06, DP-07, DP-11, DP-13 and DP-19; work package B2-S2-021 story line for RWB-S2-E2025-APP
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC8; 8 Business rules BR1 and BR7; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.2; 12.5; 12.7; 13 Solution plan; 16 Test cases
description: One combined row for the S2 slice of the legacy key. (1) The legacy story gives the treatment side one sentence and one in-process interace: section 4 step 9 says S4 and S2 read confirmed field values through DocumentFieldReader to fill the pack and the treatment record, section 12 publishes 'List<CheckedField> checkedFields(UUID caseId, String documentType)' with the members documentId, docVersion, fieldName, value, state and confidence, and section 19 puts the write into legal_action, hearing and treatment outside the key. No source states the operation, the path detail or the element names of that read once it crosses the service boundary, and RWB-P5-E2025-CON is the only place they can be fixed. (2) TSD S2 T3.1 gives treatment the fields DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-014 and DF-TRT-023 to DF-TRT-033 and none of them is a contract number, a contract amount, a contract date, a mortgage amount, a registration date, a land office, a title document number, a source document identifier, a document version or a type-table version, so the columns this slice writes are named by no source. (3) No source says which service stamps the type-table version a fact was applied under, though R-UNI-38 and CTL-08 require the version in force to be recorded with the value. (4) Six field codes of the three types this slice consumes have no column of the same name in TSD S2 T3.1 - contract_no, party_names, approval_no, approved_amount, approval_date and approval_level - and no source says whether they are carried on the treatment row, left in the hub or dropped. (5) No source gives the treatment-side masking rule for party_names; the legacy note limits unmasked values to SY-CASEWF and SY-AGENT, which excludes this service. (6) No source gives a message for a treatment row that is missing, of another case, or in a state that accepts no fact.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-025 section 4 step 9 ('S4 and S2 modules: read confirmed field values through DocumentFieldReader to fill the pack and the treatment record'), section 12 published interface ('public interface DocumentFieldReader { List<CheckedField> checkedFields(UUID caseId, String documentType); } // CheckedField: documentId, docVersion, fieldName, value, state (OK, CONFIRMED, CORRECTED), confidence') and section 19 ('Writing extracted values into legal_action, hearing or treatment (S4 in Epic 5, S2 in Epic 3)'); TSD S2 v2 T3.1 field table (DF-TRT-001 id, 002 case_id, 003 decision_log_id, 004 treatment_type, 005 proposed_by, 006 proposed_at, 007 offer_amount numeric(18,2), 008 haircut_amount numeric(18,2), 009 installments, 010 valid_until, 011 approval_level, 012 booked_at, 013 outcome, 014 outcome_at, 023 nleads_ref to 033 installment_shortfall, with no contract, mortgage, source-document or table-version field); TSD S2 v2 T3.2 (LOV-TREATMENT, LOV-PROPOSER, LOV-TRT-OUTCOME, LOV-APPROVAL-LEVEL, LOV-CREDIT-RESULT, LOV-TRT-SIGNATURE only) and T-A.1 (API-S2-001 POST /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/treatments, API-S2-002 GET /api/recovery/v1/treatments/{treatmentId}, API-S2-003 PATCH, API-S2-004 POST submit, none of them a checked-field read); FSD S2 v3 A2.1.3.1 (BR-S2-001 and no field catalog) and the screen rows SCR-14 Treatment record and SCR-15 Settlement offer; context pack S2 (table treatment is the service's one table, four REST operations provided, one event EV-10, one workflow TreatmentWorkflow); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-11 (REST contract with mock, one hop, 2 s)
area: Contract, data model and mapping of the treatment-side checked-field fill
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the P5 owner of the checked-field contract and the rwb-treatment data owner
proposed: Apply the working read of ASM-B2-S2-021-1 with RWB-P5-E2025-CON: take the operation, the payload and the element names from the contract and never guess them; add the fact and source columns of section 11 to treatment on the service's own Flyway sequence, named for the extracted codes with source_document_id, source_doc_version and source_table_version beside them; map only a field code onto a column of the same name and record the six unmapped codes as the difference; stamp the tableVersion of the reader's answer the facts were written from; mask party_names as the hub returns it and store no party name at all. Confirm the column set with the rwb-treatment data owner and the operation with the P5 contract owner at the wave 2 contract freeze.

title: Architecture v5 puts the S2 read of rwb-document on Temporal while the legacy interface and DP-11 make it one REST hop
source: Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 13 (connection matrix, row S2 Treatment, column P5 Document = T); legacy RWB-E2-025 section 12 (published in-process interface); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-11 and R5.4 class C; context pack S2 (DP table short form, S2 row); work package B2-S2-021 story line for RWB-S2-E2025-APP (C = RWB-P5-E2025-CON, patterns include DP11)
section: 1 Story; 4 Flow; 5 Exception paths X4; 7 Acceptance criteria AC6; 12.2; 12.8; 12.9; 13 Solution plan
description: The highest source and the pattern table disagree on the call type of one interaction. Architecture v5 slide 13, the connection matrix of who calls whom, marks the S2 Treatment row against the P5 Document column with T, that is a Temporal activity on the owner's queue, while legacy RWB-E2-025 section 12 publishes DocumentFieldReader as an in-process call that returns a value within the request and DP-11 turns just such a call into a REST contract with a mock, one hop and a 2 s timeout. The work package follows DP-11 and records RWB-P5-E2025-CON as the story's only contract dependency, so no Temporal activity on queue rwb-document exists to build against on Day 1, and no source states the activity name, its input or its output that the matrix would imply.
evidence: Architecture v5 slide 13 row 'S2 Treatment' reads 'T E' in the P5 column and the slide note says 'Route services reach shared capabilities through Temporal, never REST'; legacy RWB-E2-025 section 12 publishes 'List<CheckedField> checkedFields(UUID caseId, String documentType)' with no transport; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-11 reads 'In-process call, published interface | REST contract with mock; one hop; 2 s timeout' and R5.4 puts another service's CON story in class C, which does not block the build; the story line of work package B2-S2-021 lists C as RWB-P5-E2025-CON and the patterns as DP01, DP06, DP07, DP09, DP10, DP11, DP13 and DP19.
area: Call type between rwb-treatment and rwb-document
owner_role: Solution architect with the P5 contract owner and the platform Temporal owner
proposed: Keep the read as the one-hop REST contract of RWB-P5-E2025-CON with a 2 s timeout, a breaker and no retry chain, as the work package and DP-11 give it, and record the slide 13 cell as an open amendment to the architecture review; the payload, the state filter and the criteria are the same under either transport, so a later decision to move the call to Temporal rewrites CheckedFieldClient and its fake and no acceptance criterion.
